questions.s: The mosque is 6 m south of the post office. The school is 8 m east of the post office. The stadium lies 10 m to the south of the mosque. In which direction is the mosque from the post office?
questions.e: Measuring from the post office, the mosque is 6 m to the south, so the mosque is south of the post office. North is the direction of the post office from the mosque, the reverse.

questions.s: Maryam is the sister of Kamran. Usman is the son of Maryam. What is Usman to Kamran?
questions.e: Chain the statements: Kamran → Maryam → Usman. So Usman is Kamran's nephew. Maternal uncle is the reverse relation (what Kamran is to Usman).

questions.s: The school lies 35 m to the west of the post office. The hospital is 35 m south of the school. The bus stand lies 35 m to the north of the school. In which direction is the post office from the bus stand?
questions.e: Measuring from the bus stand, the post office is 35 m to the east and 35 m to the south, so the post office is south-east of the bus stand. North-west is the direction of the bus stand from the post office, the reverse.

questions.s: Zain is walking east. At successive corners he turns left, then left, then left (each turn is a right angle). In which direction is he walking after the last turn?
questions.e: Heading changes: start east, left turn → north, left turn → west, left turn → south. So he ends up walking south. North results from turning the wrong way at every corner.

questions.s: Zain is the brother of Maryam. Noor is the daughter of Zain. What is Maryam to Noor?
questions.e: Chain the statements: Maryam → Zain → Noor. So Maryam is Noor's paternal aunt (phupho). Niece is the reverse relation (what Noor is to Maryam).

questions.s: Adeel is walking north. At successive corners he turns left, then left, then left (each turn is a right angle). In which direction is he walking after the last turn?
questions.e: Heading changes: start north, left turn → west, left turn → south, left turn → east. So he ends up walking east. West results from turning the wrong way at every corner.

questions.s: Waqas starts walking south. He walks 7 m, then turns left and walks 4 m, then turns left and walks 2 m, then turns left and walks 5 m, then turns right and walks 6 m. In which direction is he now, with respect to the starting point?
questions.e: Final position: 1 m west and 1 m north of the start, so he is north-west of the starting point. South-east is the direction of the start from his position, the reverse.

questions.s: Asad walks 12 m north and then 5 m east. He then returns to the starting point in a straight line. How long is the return leg?
questions.e: The two legs are at right angles, so the return leg is the hypotenuse: √(12² + 5²) = 13 m. 17 m adds the two legs.

questions.s: Hassan is the son of Faisal. Madiha is the daughter of Hassan. Bushra is the mother of Madiha. What is Bushra to Faisal?
questions.e: Chain the statements: Faisal → Hassan → Madiha → Bushra. So Bushra is Faisal's daughter-in-law. Daughter is in the right generation but is not the relative this chain gives.

questions.s: Nida has 4 brothers and 3 sisters. How many sisters does her brother Bilal have?
questions.e: Bilal is one of her 4 brothers. His sisters are her 3 sisters and Nida herself, so 3 + 1 = 4. 3 forgets to count Nida.

questions.s: Usman is the husband of Kiran. Saima is the daughter of Usman. Farah is the sister of Saima. What is Farah to Kiran?
questions.e: Chain the statements: Kiran → Usman → Saima → Farah. So Farah is Kiran's daughter. Mother is the reverse relation (what Kiran is to Farah).

questions.s: Kiran has 3 brothers and 3 sisters. How many sisters does her brother Hassan have?
questions.e: Hassan is one of her 3 brothers. His sisters are her 3 sisters and Kiran herself, so 3 + 1 = 4. 3 forgets to count Kiran.

questions.s: Introducing a woman to a guest, Iqra says, “She is the sister of my brother's mother.” What is the woman to Iqra?
questions.e: Follow the chain from Iqra: my brother → mother → sister. The woman is Iqra's maternal aunt (khala). Niece is the reverse relation (what Iqra is to the woman), not what the woman is to Iqra.

questions.s: Faisal starts walking south. He walks 11 m, then turns left and walks 8 m, then turns left and walks 5 m. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.e: Adding up the moves, the final position is 8 m east and 6 m south of the start. Distance = √(8² + 6²) = 10 m. 14 m is not the straight-line distance.

questions.s: Maryam walks 24 km north and then 10 km east. She then returns to the starting point in a straight line. What is the total distance walked?
questions.e: The return leg is the hypotenuse: √(24² + 10²) = 26 km. Total = 24 + 10 + 26 = 60 km. 34 km leaves out the return leg.

questions.s: Madiha is the sister of Nida. Mehwish is the mother of Madiha. What is Mehwish to Nida?
questions.e: Chain the statements: Nida → Madiha → Mehwish. So Mehwish is Nida's mother. Daughter is the reverse relation (what Nida is to Mehwish).

questions.s: Danish is the brother of Omar. Amna is the sister of Danish. Ahmed is the son of Amna. What is Ahmed to Omar?
questions.e: Chain the statements: Omar → Danish → Amna → Ahmed. So Ahmed is Omar's nephew. Maternal uncle is the reverse relation (what Omar is to Ahmed).

questions.s: Introducing a man to a guest, Kiran says, “He is my sister's mother's brother.” What is the man to Kiran?
questions.e: Follow the chain from Kiran: my sister → mother → brother. The man is Kiran's maternal uncle (mamu). Paternal uncle is on the other side of the family (father's side against mother's side).

questions.s: Danish walks from the bus stop: 6 km south, then 6 km north, and finally 2 km south. In which direction is he now, with respect to the starting point?
questions.e: Net movement: no east-west change and 2 km south, so he ends south of the start. North is the direction of the start from his position, which is the reverse.

questions.s: Farah is the sister of Hina. Hamza is the son of Farah. Adeel is the father of Hamza. What is Adeel to Hina?
questions.e: Chain the statements: Hina → Farah → Hamza → Adeel. So Adeel is Hina's brother-in-law. Brother is in the right generation but is not the relative this chain gives.

questions.s: Usman points out a woman at a wedding and says, “She is the daughter of my mother's sister.” What is the woman to Usman?
questions.e: Follow the chain from Usman: my mother → sister → daughter. The woman is Usman's cousin. Sister is in the right generation but is a different kind of relative: only a child of the same parents is a brother or sister, while a cousin comes from a parent's sibling.

questions.s: Amna walks from the mosque: 3 km east, then 12 km west, then 12 km east, and finally 8 km west. In which direction is she now, with respect to the starting point?
questions.e: Net movement: 5 km west and no north-south change, so she ends west of the start. East is the direction of the start from her position, which is the reverse.

questions.s: Omar walks from the market: 2 m east, then 9 m west, and finally 7 m north. In which direction is he now, with respect to the starting point?
questions.e: Net movement: 7 m west and 7 m north, so he ends north-west of the start. South-east is the direction of the start from his position, which is the reverse.

questions.s: Bushra has 2 brothers and 1 sister. How many sisters does her brother Adeel have?
questions.e: Adeel is one of her 2 brothers. His sisters are her 1 sister and Bushra herself, so 1 + 1 = 2. 1 forgets to count Bushra.

questions.s: Tariq is facing east. He turns 180° clockwise, then 90° clockwise. In which direction is he facing now?
questions.e: Count clockwise turns as positive and anticlockwise as negative: the net turn is 270° clockwise. From east this gives north. South results from taking each turn the wrong way round.

questions.s: Hina faces west. Tariq stands back to back with Hina. In which direction does Tariq's right hand point?
questions.e: Hina faces west, so Tariq, who is back to back with Hina, faces east. Facing east, a person's right hand points south. North is where Hina's own right hand points, not Tariq's.

questions.s: Sadia's grandfather has 3 children, and each of them has 3 children of their own. How many grandchildren does the grandfather have?
questions.e: Grandchildren are the children of the grandfather's children: 3 × 3 = 9. 6 adds instead of multiplying.

questions.s: Introducing a man to a guest, Iqra says, “He is the brother of my mother.” What is the man to Iqra?
questions.e: Follow the chain from Iqra: my mother → brother. The man is Iqra's maternal uncle (mamu). Paternal uncle is on the other side of the family (father's side against mother's side).

questions.s: Introducing a man to a guest, Rabia says, “He is the son of my brother.” What is the man to Rabia?
questions.e: Follow the chain from Rabia: my brother → son. The man is Rabia's nephew. Brother-in-law belongs to a generation older than the relative this chain leads to.

questions.s: The clinic is 13 km west of the bakery. The market is 5 km north of the bakery. The stadium lies 12 km to the west of the bakery. In which direction is the market from the bakery?
questions.e: Measuring from the bakery, the market is 5 km to the north, so the market is north of the bakery. South is the direction of the bakery from the market, the reverse.

questions.s: Introducing a man to a guest, Saima says, “He is my sister's father's father.” What is the man to Saima?

questions.s: Farah faces south. Zain stands facing Farah. In which direction does Zain's right hand point?
